data.name: Oktai
data.gender_notes: Oktai is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Persian word 'Okhtai', meaning 'strong' or 'powerful'. In Islamic history, the name Oktai was borne by the Mongol leader Okhtai (Ogedei) Khan, who ruled the Mongol Empire from 1229 to 1242. The name Oktai carries the meaning “Strong, Powerful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Oktai usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, powerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing strength and power from a noble Persian heritage.
data.etymology: Oktai belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong, Powerful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Oktai total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
